goals: Implement a transactional commerce engine coordinating inventory, wallet, coupons, and order fulfillment.
Ensure strict inventory invariants (available vs reserved stock).
Guarantee payment idempotency and double-entry ledger integrity.
Implement a robust Order Saga state machine with automatic compensating transactions (rollbacks).
Provide a global accounting reconciliation mechanism to verify system balance.
actors: Customer: Places orders, deposits funds, uses coupons.
Warehouse Manager: Registers products, fulfills (ships) orders.
System Auditor: Performs reconciliation and reviews audit logs.
user_flows: Checkout Flow: Validate Stock/Coupon -> Reserve Stock/Quota -> Debit Wallet -> Transition to PAID.
Payment Failure Flow: Reserve Stock/Quota -> Insufficient Funds -> Release Stock/Quota -> Transition to FAILED_PAYMENT.
Fulfillment Flow: PAID Order -> Commit Stock -> Transition to SHIPPED.
Cancellation Flow: PAID/RESERVED Order -> Release Stock/Quota -> Refund Wallet (if PAID) -> Transition to CANCELLED.
Funding Flow: Create Wallet -> Deposit Funds (Idempotent) -> Update Ledger.

states.description: Stock and coupon quota are held; payment is pending.
Payment failed; stock and quota restored.
Order voided; stock restored; payment refunded if applicable.

business_rules: Stock Invariant: available_stock + reserved_stock must remain constant during reservation/release.
Payment Idempotency: A ledger entry with a duplicate idempotency_key must not change the wallet balance.
Coupon Quota: current_uses must be incremented on reservation and decremented on FAILED_PAYMENT or CANCELLED.
Order State Guard: ship_order only allowed from PAID; cancel_order only allowed from RESERVED or PAID.
Atomic Checkout: If any item in an order lacks sufficient available_stock, the entire order fails (no partial reservations).
Non-Negative Balance: Wallet balance cannot drop below 0.
ui_views: Order Audit Log: Chronological list of state transitions for a specific order.
System Reconciliation Report: Summary of debits, refunds, net captured, and balance check.
edge_cases: Concurrent checkout attempts for the last item in stock.
Payment failure exactly at the moment of wallet deduction.
Attempting to cancel an order that has already been shipped.
Applying a coupon that reaches its max_uses limit during the checkout process.
Duplicate idempotency keys provided for wallet deposits.
design_decisions: Use SQLite for persistence to ensure ACID properties across the four subsystems.
Represent all currency as integers (cents) to avoid floating-point precision errors.
Implement the Order Saga as a coordinated sequence of method calls within a database transaction.
Use a dedicated audit_logs table to track state transitions for observability.
assumptions: The system is standalone and does not rely on external payment gateways (internal wallet only).
The `idempotency_key` is provided by the client for deposits and checkouts.
Python 3.9+ standard library is used for all implementations.

methods.name: register_product
methods.signature: (sku: str, name: str, price_cents: int, initial_stock: int) -> None

methods.name: deposit_funds
methods.signature: (customer_id: str, amount_cents: int, idempotency_key: str) -> None

methods.name: create_coupon
methods.signature: (code: str, discount_percent: int, max_uses: int, min_order_cents: int = 0) -> None

methods.name: checkout_order
methods.signature: (customer_id: str, items: list[dict], coupon_code: str | None = None, idempotency_key: str | None = None) -> dict

database_ddl: CREATE TABLE products (sku TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price_cents INTEGER, available_stock INTEGER, reserved_stock INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE wallets (customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, balance_cents INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE ledger_entries (entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT, order_id TEXT, entry_type TEXT, amount_cents INTEGER, idempotency_key TEXT UNIQUE, FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES wallets(customer_id))
CREATE TABLE coupons (code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, discount_percent INTEGER, max_uses INTEGER, current_uses INTEGER, min_order_cents INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, customer_id TEXT, subtotal_cents INTEGER, discount_cents INTEGER, final_total_cents INTEGER, status TEXT, coupon_code TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES wallets(customer_id), FOREIGN KEY(coupon_code) REFERENCES coupons(code))
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id TEXT, sku TEXT, quantity INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(order_id, sku), FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id), FOREIGN KEY(sku) REFERENCES products(sku))

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (log_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, order_id TEXT, event_type TEXT, from_state TEXT, to_state TEXT, timestamp DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders(order_id))
